real: Peresvet-class laser dazzler on an MZKT-type 8x8 chassis; 12.7 mm RWS for self-defence
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p27_wave1c): a Peresvet class dazzler, 9.0 x 2.76 x 3.83 m, an 8x8 EW truck whose shelter carries a lift frame with a large forward-facing housing of six glowing lenses (two rows of three, bezels and glass), a roof remote weapon station, door panels, vents and side lockers; team bands on both sides; no real insignia.

the grille, the bumper, headlamps, the beacon
eight wheels on four axles in two pairs, walking beams, axle beams, mud flaps
the long equipment shelter with doors, lockers, louvred vents, roof vents, rails, ladder, corner castings
the lens housing on its scissor lift frame and rams: six lenses in two rows with bezels, glass and glowing cores, the sun hood
the rear generator with grille and exhaust stack, the cable reel, the spare wheel, stowage
the remote 12.7 mm station on a raised ring over the cab, its sensor head (Turret)
